name: HTMX GET
description: Django URL-backed HTMX GET button
usage: The view returns the HTML fragment that should replace the selected target.

name: HTMX CSRF-safe POST
description: CSRF-safe Django form submitted through HTMX
usage: The POST view validates the submitted fields and returns the replacement fragment for the selected target.

name: HTMX DELETE
description: CSRF-safe Django delete form submitted through POST
usage: The POST view performs the deletion and returns either an empty response or replacement markup for the item.

name: HTMX Search
description: Debounced Django HTMX search input
usage: The search view reads the input value and returns the current result-list fragment.

name: HTMX Form Validation
description: Django form replaced with server-rendered validation state
usage: The view returns the complete bound form with HTTP 200 when invalid, or a complete success fragment when valid.

name: HTMX File Upload
description: CSRF-safe multipart file upload with a status target
usage: The upload view reads request.FILES, validates the file, and returns success or error markup for the upload-result target.

name: HTMX Bulk Actions
description: CSRF-safe bulk action form for Django objects
usage: The POST view processes every selected value and returns a complete tbody element with the same id.

name: HTMX Dependent Dropdown
description: Django select that loads options for a dependent field
usage: The options view reads the selected parent value and returns option elements for the dependent select.

name: HTMX 4 validation response
description: HTMX 4 Django form with status-specific validation handling
usage: Requires HTMX 4. Return validation HTML with status 422, and success HTML for the result container. Server error responses do not swap.

name: HTMX Infinite Scroll
description: Load the next Django page when revealed
usage: The list view returns the next result fragment followed by a new next-page trigger when another page exists.

name: HTMX Poll
description: Poll a Django view until work is complete
usage: The status view returns the same polling region while work continues and omits hx-trigger after completion.

name: HTMX Lazy Loading
description: Load a Django fragment when its placeholder appears
usage: The fragment view returns the complete replacement section without aria-busy.

name: HTMX Boosted Navigation
description: Progressively enhance Django navigation with history updates
usage: Each linked view returns a normal full page containing the same main-content element, which hx-select extracts.

name: HTMX Progress
description: Poll server-rendered progress for a Django task
usage: The progress view returns updated markup and omits hx-trigger when the task reaches a terminal state.

name: HTMX Click to Edit
description: Replace a Django object summary with an edit form
usage: The edit view returns a CSRF-protected form that targets and replaces itself after submission.

name: HTMX Editable Table Row
description: Replace a Django table row with server-rendered editing controls
usage: The edit view returns a complete replacement row containing a CSRF-protected update form.

name: HTMX Dialog
description: Load a script-free non-modal dialog from a Django view
usage: The view returns a dialog with the same id, the open attribute, a labelled title, and a native method="dialog" close form; it is non-modal without showModal().

name: HTMX Modal
description: Load a Django view into a fixed CSS-only modal overlay
usage: The modal view returns the overlay markup with underlay/close controls that target the same container and swap it empty to close; no JavaScript is required.

name: HTMX Server-driven Tabs
description: Replace server-rendered tabs and selected state
usage: The tabs view returns the complete section with updated tablist, aria-selected state, and panel content.

name: HTMX 4 morph refresh
description: HTMX 4 state-preserving refresh
usage: Requires HTMX 4. The view returns the region contents. Use stable element IDs to help morphing preserve focus and state.

name: HTMX Out-of-band Swap
description: Update a second region from a Django HTMX response
usage: Return this fragment alongside the primary response; HTMX replaces the existing element with the matching id.

name: HTMX Toast Notification
description: Append an accessible notification from an HTMX response
usage: Return this fragment with a primary response to append its status message to the existing notifications region.

name: HTMX 4 partial response
description: HTMX 4 response fragment with explicit target and swap
usage: Requires HTMX 4. Return one or more hx-partial elements to update multiple targets. This is an HTMX response element, separate from Django partialdef template tags.

name: Django Partial Definition
description: Define a Django 6 template partial
usage: Django 6 registers the named block as a reusable partial in the current template.

name: Django Inline Partial Definition
description: Define and render an inline Django 6 template partial
usage: Django 6 registers and renders the named partial at its definition site.

name: Render Django Partial
description: Render a same-file Django 6 template partial
usage: The referenced partial must be defined in the same template or resolved through Django's supported partial syntax.
